title: Structurally Different, Functionally Persistent: Capability Regions Under Model Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.27445v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) capabilities have been associated with localized parameter regions, enabling targeted model editing and intervention. However, it remains unclear whether a region identified before model optimization remains an effective intervention target afterward. We evaluate the functional persistence and parameter overlap of coding capability regions across three instruction-tuned models under quantization, pruning, and LoRA-based adaptation. Although re-extracted regions exhibit substantial parameter reorganization, ablating the original region after optimization eliminates or nearly eliminates coding performance in almost all conditions, while magnitude-matched controls preserve performance. Partition analysis further shows that the shared subset of the original and re-extracted regions accounts for most of the observed ablation effect in the majority of conditions. translated_title: 结构不同，功能持久：模型优化下的能力区域
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）的能力已被认为与局部化的参数区域相关联，这使得针对性的模型编辑和干预成为可能。然而，目前尚不清楚在模型优化之前识别出的区域在优化之后是否仍然是有效的干预目标。我们在三个指令微调模型上，评估了在量化、剪枝以及基于LoRA的适配过程中编码能力区域的功能持久性和参数重叠情况。尽管重新提取的区域表现出显著的参数重组，但在几乎所有条件下，优化后消融原始区域会消除或几乎消除编码性能，而幅度匹配的对照区域则保持性能不变。分区分析进一步表明，在大多数条件下，原始区域与重新提取区域之间的重叠子集占了所观察到的消融效果的大部分。这些结果表明，参数重叠与功能持久性（原文在此截断）……
tldr: 该研究通过对量化、剪枝和LoRA适配的分析发现，尽管模型优化会导致能力区域发生显著的参数重组，但优化前识别的编码能力区域在功能上依然持久——消融这些原始区域仍能消除编码性能，表明它们始终是有效的干预目标。
en_tdlr: This study shows that although model optimization induces substantial parameter reorganization of capability regions under quantization, pruning, and LoRA adaptation, coding capability regions identified before optimization remain functionally persistent, as ablating them still eliminates or nearly eliminates coding performance, making them reliable and effective intervention targets.
